summary: Aircraft with wingspan over 64 m have restricted access to taxiways B and G at EGVN.
text:
AIRCRAFT WITH WINGSPAN GREATER THAN 64M HAVE RESTRICTED ACCESS
TO TWY B AND TWY G AND SHOULD EXPECT TO TURN ON RUNWAY END LOOPS
AND BACKTRACK TO DISPERSAL. ALL VISITING AIRCRAFT REQUIRE A RAMP
SERVICES MARSHALLER BEFORE REQUESTING START OR GROUND MOVEMENT
CLEARANCE. AIRCRAFT MAY ENCOUNTER VEHICLES ON THE AERODROME WHICH 
MAY NOT BE IN CONTACT WITH ATC. FOLLOW ME SERVICE AVAILABLE ON
REQUEST THROUGH ATC.
